title: Fitz's Job: Kelp Eels
description: *hic*... Good work! You're a chip off the ole dock, aren't ya matey? I need 2 Kelp Eels for a... client of mine. Kelp Eels love shrimp and shady waters! Try searching the islands for kelp beds - look for dark, kelp-covered waters.

objectives.description: Catch 2 Kelp Eels. Tip: Use shrimp bait in kelp beds - search the islands for shady kelp-covered waters.
